title: Model Supply Readiness Ledger and Tactical Triggers
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create and operationalize a cross-regional ledger that captures model supply readiness signals (availability, quantization compatibility, latency footprint, provisioning time) and pair that with tactical triggers and playbooks so Platform, Sales, and Ops can respond to supply degradation or model outages within agreed SLOs.
objective: Deliver a maintainable ledger and alerting runway that quantifies model readiness across NA/EU/APAC, defines measurable triggers for automated escalation and fallback, and produces runbooks and tabletop exercises to validate operational responses.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Ledger populated for the top 12 prioritized models across NA/EU/APAC including fields: availability_score, quant_compat_score, expected_latency_p50, expected_latency_p95, provisioning_time_est (hours). 2) Three tactical triggers documented with numeric thresholds (latency breach, supply capacity drop, quant incompatibility) and mapped alert routes. 3) Grafana dashboard and PagerDuty integration live with synthetic probes feeding the ledger. 4) Two tabletop runthroughs executed with postmortem/retros and runbook updates.
tasks: Inventory current model catalog and probe endpoints to collect p50/p95 latency across regions
Design ledger schema (CSV/BigQuery/GSheet options) and validation checks; publish schema in Confluence
Implement collection job to run synthetic probes hourly and write to ledger with backoff/jitter to avoid vendor rate limits
Define threshold values for tactical triggers and map to alert channels (PagerDuty/Console/Slack)
Draft operational playbooks for Sales, Platform, and Oncall with decision matrix and rollback steps
Integrate ledger with Console dashboards and add Grafana panels + alerts
Schedule and run two tabletop exercises; capture learnings and iterate on runbooks
risks: Synthetic probe infra may be rate-limited by vendors, producing false availability drops
Private/VPC customers may restrict probe reachability, reducing coverage
Different teams have varying definitions of 'quantization compatibility' leading to inconsistent scoring
comments: 2025-02-11 - Ava Patel: Kickoff w/ Platform & Sales. Agreed on top 12 models and regional scope NA/EU/APAC. Action: Platform to provide probe runner access by 2025-02-14.

2025-03-02 - Liam Chen: Begun wiring alerting to PD service 'model-supply-ops'. Next: validate thresholds against historical traces and run first tabletop on 2025-03-14.
